title: How a P-Trap Protects Your Home
description: The P-trap sits directly below sink strainers to perform a simple yet critical function: maintaining a continuous liquid barrier against sewer gases. Every time a sink runs, wastewater flows through the dip of the trap and out to the main drain line. When water flow stops, a small volume remains trapped in the curved section. This standing water blocks foul air and dangerous gases from rising up through the drain opening. If a sink goes unused for months, this water can evaporate, breaking the protective seal.

How a P-Trap Protects Your Home

The P-trap sits directly below sink strainers to perform a simple yet critical function: maintaining a continuous liquid barrier against sewer gases. Every time a sink runs, wastewater flows through the dip of the trap and out to the main drain line. When water flow stops, a small volume remains trapped in the curved section. This standing water blocks foul air and dangerous gases from rising up through the drain opening. If a sink goes unused for months, this water can evaporate, breaking the protective seal.
